checks.conclusion: Projection replaces each selected one-UTF16-unit code point with one unit; all original offsets remain comparable. It changes the parsing view globally, so original literal repair is necessary. This is selected lexer compensation, not a JS validity proof.
checks.negative_witness: U+2003 inside a quoted import would otherwise become an ASCII-space target; deleting trivia would shift offsets.
checks.conditional_removal_gate: Retire only with a selected lexer/API qualified on original-domain literal/trivia/comment offsets; no second local string decoder.

checks.conclusion: For N original U+2028/U+2029 units, at most N restorations and N+1 main-view parses occur. Every restoration requires an integral error offset, projected LF and original separator; a restored unit cannot satisfy the same LF guard again. Zero count/nonintegral/unbacked offsets immediately rethrow.
checks.negative_witness: Unconditional retry can loop or conceal unrelated errors; globally restoring separators can hide real comment-boundary imports.

checks.conclusion: Only original literal n is replaced. Static bounds include surrounding delimiters via s-1/e+1; dynamic bounds use s/e. Synthetic import( contributes seven UTF16 units, so synthetic idx+start-7 restores the original coordinate. The synthetic path does not retry; unrelated no-idx failures propagate.
checks.negative_witness: Replacing the complete synthetic record would transplant offsets; original[0] non-null depends on selected literal-span invariant, already recorded as a gap.

checks.conclusion: Raw lookup overwrites best for every eligible source-order segment, so exact duplicates are last-wins. trace-mapping exact GLB selects lowerBound, so ordinary sorted nonnegative duplicate maps still need a small last-wins coalescing bridge. Whole effectiveLine removal is not equivalent merely after sorted/nonnegative admission.
checks.negative_witness: Same-column mapped/name/unmapped ties switch winner with direct stock GLB.
checks.conditional_removal_gate: Retire prefix maxima only under selected producer/public/stored-map profile; separately preserve or disposition ordinary duplicate winners.

checks.conclusion: Sourceless/invalid-source winners refuse mapping rather than falling back to earlier mapped points. Missing lines receive explicit unmapped seeds because remapping skips null traces. No-edit pass-through precedes map reads. Own staged-map presence prevents stale artifact fallback. mapThrownError contains diagnostic failures, but composeModuleMap catches only original decode, not all later composer failures.
checks.negative_witness: Fallback to an artifact map after changed-length rewrite can fabricate wrong authored columns; deeper-frame fallback changes first-classifying-frame behavior.

checks.conclusion: Opaque IDs preserve original table-index identity through library resolution/dedup; restore compact output indices before reusing original tables. Empty strings can remain valid raw source/name values. Array negative properties/holes and host getters/proxies are explicitly outside current composition certification; raw lookup admission is broader.
checks.negative_witness: Passing raw sourceRoot/duplicate sources directly to library may resolve or collapse them; sources[-1] can pass raw lookup without a corresponding opaque composition ID.

checks.conclusion: Carrier loop bounds each source-index/original-line/original-column/name delta by 0x3fffffff, retaining large accumulated endpoints as equal-column steps. It does not certify stock host duplicate lookup or repair arbitrary generated-column encoding. Current proposal remains conditional, separate from ordinary duplicate semantics.
checks.negative_witness: Dropping carriers while keeping accepted large endpoints can wrap line/column/name deltas; stock GLB can choose the first carrier.
checks.conditional_removal_gate: Direct encode only after real profile proves safe per-field deltas and preserves remaining tie/index restoration.

checks.conclusion: Pinned cookie parser deduplicates raw ASCII-trimmed keys; wrapper selects first ECMAScript-trim matching group. Empty or malformed selected value immediately returns null; later duplicates cannot rescue it. Raw trim precedes exactly one strict URI decode; literal quotes survive, semicolons split quotes, and decoded whitespace is not retrimmed.
checks.negative_witness: can_session=; can_session=good and malformed-first percent escapes remain null; %252F becomes %2F, quoted foo retains quotes, %20x%20 retains surrounding decoded spaces.

checks.conclusion: Encoding occurs before domain validation, preserving lone-surrogate error precedence. Reorder acts on bounded library-generated segments with fixed options. Removing reorder can preserve semantic attrs but changes exact bytes and later option reads; readonly types permit getters, and domain/secure are reread in the current adapter.
checks.negative_witness: Caching secure/domain can change getter effects or the branch selecting generated segment positions even when ordinary object fixtures pass.
checks.conditional_removal_gate: External byte-order consumer/profile disposition plus plain stable option-value domain or preserved property-read/evaluation-order effects; keep security defaults, clear attrs, domain validation and encoding.

checks.conclusion: Password decoder masks only unused final sextet bits after alphabet/remainder guards to retain historical byte aliases. Bearer creation/lookups hash presented text through UTF8, not normalized decoded token bytes. Password envelope validates algorithm/four parts, numeric integral positive bounded iterations and fixed decoded lengths.
checks.negative_witness: Applying password byte-alias normalization to bearer hashes collapses distinct presented token strings and changes security/persisted identity.

checks.conclusion: Unequal byte lengths return false before native comparison; equal empty values still invoke native. Worker missing primitive refuses; invocation retains subtle receiver. Password derivation failures return false, while native comparison faults propagate outside that catch. Timing-safe claim is confined to the native primitive.
checks.negative_witness: A JS fallback, equal-empty shortcut, detached receiver, or wider password catch changes host refusal/fault semantics.
